#!/bin/bash
# Live probe battery for TIME OFF group. Sources env.sh; never prints the key.
source /tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/env.sh
WS="$CLOCKIFY_WORKSPACE_ID"
BASE="https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/workspaces/$WS"
H="X-Api-Key: $CLOCKIFY_API_KEY"
TS=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
OUT=/tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/probes
mkdir -p "$OUT"

req() { # req <label> <method> <path> [body]
  local label="$1" method="$2" path="$3" body="$4"
  local code hdrfile="$OUT/${label}.hdr" bodyfile="$OUT/${label}.json"
  if [ -n "$body" ]; then
    code=$(curl -s -m 40 -D "$hdrfile" -o "$bodyfile" -w "%{http_code}" -X "$method" -H "$H" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$body" "$BASE$path")
  else
    code=$(curl -s -m 40 -D "$hdrfile" -o "$bodyfile" -w "%{http_code}" -X "$method" -H "$H" "$BASE$path")
  fi
  echo "$TS|$method|$path|$code|$label" >> "$OUT/records.tsv"
  echo "== $label: $method $path -> HTTP $code"
  head -c 400 "$bodyfile" | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/\(X-Api-Key[^ ]*\)/X-Api-Key:<redacted>/g'
  echo
}

P_DAYS="696fd7f25dd6c5510bafa772"
P_HOURS="6967f523d3e5101589b5b66e"
# pick a user id from the DAYS policy's userIds
USER_ID=$(python3 -c "
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/clockify-openapi-audit/live-policies.json'))
for p in d:
    if p['id']=='$P_DAYS':
        print(p['userIds'][0] if p['userIds'] else '')
        break
")
echo "USER_ID=$USER_ID"

echo "### 1. sort-order acceptance on policies list"
req so-asc   GET  "/time-off/policies?sort-order=ASCENDING&page-size=5"
req so-desc  GET  "/time-off/policies?sort-order=DESCENDING&page-size=5"
req so-bogus GET  "/time-off/policies?sort-order=BOGUS&page-size=5"

echo "### 2. GET one policy (fields incl. color/icon/hasExpiration)"
req get-pol  GET  "/time-off/policies/$P_DAYS"

echo "### 3. POST create policy WITHOUT approve object"
req create-noapprove POST "/time-off/policies" '{"name":"DSAUDIT_approve_optional_'"$TS"'","timeUnit":"DAYS","color":"#123456","icon":"PLANE","hasExpiration":false,"allowHalfDay":false,"allowNegativeBalance":false,"everyoneIncludingNew":false,"archived":false}'

echo "### 3b. POST create policy WITH approve object"
req create-withapprove POST "/time-off/policies" '{"name":"DSAUDIT_approve_present_'"$TS"'","timeUnit":"HOURS","approve":{"requiresApproval":true,"specificMembers":false,"teamManagers":false,"userIds":["'$USER_ID'"]},"hasExpiration":false,"archived":false}'

echo "### 4. PUT update policy (replace semantics + filter shape + status ACTIVE)"
req put-filter-active PUT "/time-off/policies/$P_DAYS" '{"name":"1111","timeUnit":"DAYS","allowHalfDay":true,"allowNegativeBalance":false,"archived":false,"everyoneIncludingNew":true,"hasExpiration":false,"approve":{"requiresApproval":true,"specificMembers":false,"teamManagers":false,"userIds":[]},"users":{"contains":"CONTAINS","ids":["'$USER_ID'"],"status":"ACTIVE"},"userGroups":{"contains":"CONTAINS","ids":[],"status":"ACTIVE"}}'

echo "### 4b. PUT update policy with status ALL instead of ACTIVE"
req put-filter-all PUT "/time-off/policies/$P_DAYS" '{"name":"1111","timeUnit":"DAYS","allowHalfDay":true,"allowNegativeBalance":false,"archived":false,"everyoneIncludingNew":true,"hasExpiration":false,"approve":{"requiresApproval":true,"specificMembers":false,"teamManagers":false,"userIds":[]},"users":{"contains":"CONTAINS","ids":["'$USER_ID'"],"status":"ALL"},"userGroups":{"contains":"CONTAINS","ids":[],"status":"ALL"}}'

echo "### 5. PATCH policy status -> ARCHIVED"
req patch-archived PATCH "/time-off/policies/$P_DAYS" '{"status":"ARCHIVED"}'
